meaning: Under part N1 and the two explicit selected-world dictionary bridges, an existing simple remote being excludes a numerically distinct pair of existents. Remoteness rules out its proper-part status; simplicity then transfers negatively to the whole, which cannot have an existing proper component. A proposed distinct pair yields incompatible double-negated identities with the same whole. No excluded middle, positive identity conclusion or actual whole-existence assertion is used.

strong_version_needed.STMT-NATURALISM-N1: This comparison tests N1 over every existing candidate. The conclusion ranges over the remote/simple candidate, both population witnesses, or the selected whole without a supplied concreteness predicate or an all-existents-concrete bridge. N2 would constrain only the concrete subset and would need an additional explicit classification bridge; that is a different configuration, not a replacement justified by this signature.
